note: TOWN_LIFE §3.1 (TL-A2): talking while standing in a group: the right hand leads the gestures (an open-palm beat, an offer outward), the left joins for a two-handed explain and an open-palm shrug, with nods and a glance; a 3 s loop. The hands are open and turn palm-up while they gesture (so it never reads as a fighting guard, TOWN_LIFE §3.1). Legs stay on the idle (STAND1 frame 0), so the feet never move. Arms are ABSOLUTE angles on the idle: [swing forward, elbow bend, abduct out]. hands: [open 0..1 (the fingers toward the bind pose's open hand), palm (deg, + turns the palm up)]. lean = spine forward, head = nod forward, headYaw = + looks left, twist = + turns the chest left. Shared by both skeletons.
